resourceProfile.assessment: Canonical English, the complete effective es-419 locale, UI context, glossary, protected-token rules, and an independent linguistic pass were available locally.

automatedQuality.summary: Translation review, queue validation, type checking, tests, and the complete production build passed.

linguisticCritique.summary: An independent machine critique reviewed shared UI, all calculators, catalogs, and comparison pages.

competentHumanReview.summary: No competent Latin American Spanish human review was performed; corrections remain machine reviewed.

publicationAuthorization.summary: The owner requested translation improvement, not publication or deployment.

findings.summary: The symbols M, m, and n were translated as words.
evidence: SI symbols are case-sensitive and must not be translated.
findings.resolution: Restored M, m, μ, and n and normalized the nano factor.

findings.summary: The draft changed 1 MΩ to 1 mΩ.
evidence: Megaohms and milliohms differ by a factor of one billion.
findings.resolution: Restored 1 MΩ = 1.000.000 Ω and normalized the related conversion formatting.

findings.summary: The Kelvin symbol K was lowercased.
evidence: K is the case-sensitive SI symbol for kelvin.
findings.resolution: Restored K.

findings.summary: The lbf force symbol was replaced by the mass word libra.
evidence: The source explicitly distinguishes lb mass from lbf force.
findings.resolution: Restored 1 lbf ≈ 4,44822 N and the °C symbol in the Kelvin conversion.

findings.summary: Gauge diameters mixed decimal conventions and expanded the mm symbol.
evidence: 2.588 milímetros can be read as 2,588 millimetres in Spanish notation.
findings.resolution: Used decimal commas and preserved mm throughout the table.

findings.summary: Retry was rendered as Rever.
evidence: Rever is not the intended Spanish retry action.
findings.resolution: Changed it to Reintentar.

findings.summary: Catalog-manager labels had broken agreement and literal word order.
evidence: Dynamic nouns were inserted into adjective positions that produced ungrammatical labels.
findings.resolution: Rephrased manager actions with neutral element wording, natural de constructions, and consistent informal address.

findings.summary: The help text mistranslated mod and obscured the safer-limit rule.
evidence: The text explains safety-relevant battery limits and package dimensions.
findings.resolution: Rewrote the guidance in clear Latin American Spanish while preserving the safer derived-limit behavior.

findings.summary: Mods and control boards were translated as modifications and plates.
evidence: These are vaping-device and electronics product terms.
findings.resolution: Used mods and tarjetas de control and improved surrounding home-page fluency.

findings.summary: The label en vapear was ungrammatical.
evidence: A section heading requires a noun phrase.
findings.resolution: Changed it to En el vapeo.

findings.summary: Drenaje de batería contradicted the locale glossary.
evidence: The glossary prefers consumo de batería.
findings.resolution: Used Consumo de batería.

findings.summary: Current headroom became margen actual, meaning present margin.
evidence: Current refers to electrical current in this battery warning.
findings.resolution: Used margen de corriente and preserved the 20 % threshold.

findings.summary: Continuous output and device overhead were mistranslated.
evidence: Producción and sobrecarga change the electrical meaning.
findings.resolution: Used salida continua, autonomía, and consumo del dispositivo.

findings.summary: The coil workflow description was machine-literal and unclear.
evidence: The calculator estimates wraps, resistance, and heating from wire and build parameters.
findings.resolution: Rewrote the description with alambre, parámetros de construcción, and vueltas.

findings.summary: Envoltura de bobinas suggested packaging rather than winding.
evidence: The page is a coil-wrapping calculator.
findings.resolution: Used Calculadora de bobinado de resistencias.

findings.summary: Needle gauge was rendered as a measuring instrument.
evidence: BWG names a gauge system.
findings.resolution: Used BWG (calibre de aguja).

findings.summary: Lugares decimales was an unnatural calque.
evidence: Decimales is the concise UI label.
findings.resolution: Used Decimales.

findings.summary: The infeasible-mixture remediation was grammatically broken.
evidence: The original obscured which nicotine, VG, PG, and flavor values to change.
findings.resolution: Rewrote the full remediation with explicit adjustment options.

findings.summary: The compact unit symbol g was expanded to gramos.
evidence: Unit identity and compact table layout require the symbol.
findings.resolution: Restored g.

findings.summary: Electrical current was mistranslated as current-in-time.
evidence: The constraint is an amperage limit.
findings.resolution: Used límite de corriente and restored the W unit without punctuation.

findings.summary: Resistencia básica was misleading for the 20 °C reference value.
evidence: The value normalizes the temperature-resistance curve.
findings.resolution: Used resistencia de referencia across all three related labels.

findings.summary: Single became Soltero and wraps became Envolturas.
evidence: The labels describe a wire construction and coil turns, not a person or packaging.
findings.resolution: Used Simple and Vueltas.

findings.summary: The swap action lacked accents and authenticity labels used the wrong grammatical form.
evidence: The authenticity values describe a feminine batería.
findings.resolution: Used Intercambiar baterías, Sospechosa, and Falsificada.

findings.summary: Tablero was an awkward rendering of an electronics control board.
evidence: The site wording identifies control-board products as tarjetas de control.
findings.resolution: Used tarjeta de control in the affected comparison messages.

findings.summary: Eléctricas was missing its accent.
evidence: Spanish orthography requires the accent.
findings.resolution: Used Propiedades eléctricas.
